description: Events that are on at this moment in Latvia (kas notiek tagad: started and not yet ended, by Riga time), optionally in one city or category.

category.description: Category, in English or Latvian, any form: Music (concerts, koncerti), Theater (izrādes, teātris), Movie (cinema, kino), Comedy (stand-up), Dance (dejas), Exhibition (izstādes, muzeji), Festival (festivāli), Sports (sports), Food (degustācijas), Education (workshops, meistarklases, lekcijas), Family (kids, bērniem), Nightlife (ballītes, klubi), Market (tirdziņi). list_categories names them all.

city.description: City or town in Latvia (pilsēta), e.g. Rīga, Riga, Liepāja, Jūrmala, Cēsis. Diacritics optional. list_cities names them all.

limit.description: How many events to return (default 20, at most 50).

name: events_happening_now
title: Events on right now
